case: Steel 4130 tab 30 mm wide, 4 mm thick, 40 mm from welded root to load; 500 N through the thickness as a uniform traction on the free end; root face fully fixed. Other tool: scikit-fem 12.0.2, 27-node hexahedra.
compared: KinematiK root-bending stress (screen_bracket, lever arm = distance from the section to the load) against the FEA top-surface stress sxx at sections 2t and more from the root and from the load
reported_without_limit: FEA stress at the root itself (the fixed face concentrates stress at its edges; the screening does not claim that, it carries screening_only)
